note: THE LEGO CATALOG. Every reusable building block found while indexing the source slides. Each block: where it lives in the content region (canvas-frame.md), exact geometry, and a COPY RECIPE you follow verbatim — never re-invent. All text inside blocks is 9.5pt (12.7px) Source Sans Pro unless noted; only slide titles are 14pt. Colours via --deal-* / neutral tokens. Blocks are dropped into the 12-col content grid (x20→1260, y84→672) until it is filled edge-to-edge.

conventions.labelCaps: 9.5pt, bold, letter-spacing .08em, text-transform uppercase (small-caps device). NOT a smaller size.
conventions.grid: content region = 12 cols × 1240px, 16px gutter, 16px row gap
conventions.fills: navy/deal-primary fills only on: KPI tiles, category header bars, chart series, section bars. Panels = grey band header + white body. Placeholders = dashed grey box; company/target logo = yellow box, red 1px border, 'COMPANY LOGO' 9.5pt caps.

BLK-KPI-TILE-GRID.name: KPI tile grid
BLK-KPI-TILE-GRID.exitWidth: leaves a ~468px-wide left column beneath it (docks BLK-DESCRIPTION); right of it is the chart region
BLK-KPI-TILE-GRID.region: top-left; DO NOT resize to fill — text fits the box, box never grows
BLK-KPI-TILE-GRID.recipe: grid 3col×2row, gap 8px. Each tile: background var(--deal-primary); color #fff; padding 8px; center; value line 700 ~15px on top; label below in labelCaps (9.5pt bold caps, opacity .9). Values like '€[x]m','[x]%'; labels 'REVENUE FY25B','RE(OC)CURRING REV.','EBITDA MARGIN','c.[x] FTEs','>[x] CUSTOMERS','[x] YEARS OF EXPERIENCE'. Optional square bullet line beneath the grid.

BLK-BARCHART-CAGR.name: Column chart with CAGR bracket + forecast bar
BLK-BARCHART-CAGR.geometry: solid deal-primary bars for actuals; final bar HATCHED (budget/forecast) via repeating-linear-gradient; value label 9.5pt bold above each bar; category labels below (FY22A…FY25B); grey CAGR bracket (horizontal line + right arrow) spanning first→last with '[x]% CAGR' 9.5pt centered; optional rotated axis label left ('LFL (€m)' / 'REVENUE (€m)').
BLK-BARCHART-CAGR.recipe: Use component ColumnChart (mode=simple/stacked). Mark forecast bar with hatch fill. Overlay a CagrPill or a CSS bracket. All labels 9.5pt.

BLK-COMBO-BAR-LINE.name: Combo bars + margin % line
BLK-COMBO-BAR-LINE.geometry: deal-primary bars (EBITDA €m) + last bar hatched; a thin line with %-labels above (EBITDA-margin %); legend row beneath: ■ EBITDA (€m) / — EBITDA-margin (%). All 9.5pt.
BLK-COMBO-BAR-LINE.recipe: ColumnChart for bars + an absolutely-positioned polyline (SVG) for the margin line with % text nodes (9.5pt). Legend = flex row, 9.5pt.

BLK-DASHBOARD-PANEL.name: Grey dashboard panel (multi sub-chart)
BLK-DASHBOARD-PANEL.anchor: BOTTOM-RIGHT of content region, flush to figure edge
BLK-DASHBOARD-PANEL.exitWidth: occupies right 756px → leaves a ~468px docking slot on the LEFT (matches BLK-DESCRIPTION / left column width). 3 sub-cells ~240px each, separated by 0.25pt vertical rules
BLK-DASHBOARD-PANEL.region: bottom-right; DO NOT stretch to full width — this is the v1 mistake
BLK-DASHBOARD-PANEL.recipe: flex row of sub-cells, each: PanelHeader-style caps title (9.5pt) + chart. Vertical divider = border-left 0.25pt grey between cells.

BLK-DONUT-LABELLED.name: Donut with centre label + outer callouts
BLK-DONUT-LABELLED.geometry: Donut component; centre label = name + '€[x]m' (9.5pt); segment % in-ring white 9.5pt; outer [x] leader callouts optional. Colours deal-chart ramp.
BLK-DONUT-LABELLED.recipe: Use Donut with centerLabel + centerSub; segments labelled. 9.5pt everywhere.

BLK-STACKED-AREA-SHARE.name: Stacked area — recurring vs reoccurring
BLK-STACKED-AREA-SHARE.geometry: two stacked area bands across FY22A→LTM with % labels inside each band (9.5pt white); legend ■ RECURRING / ■ REOCCURRING above. deal ramp fills.
BLK-STACKED-AREA-SHARE.recipe: SVG stacked area (2 series) + % text nodes (9.5pt) + flex legend.

BLK-MATRIX-ROW-LAYOUT.name: Row-label × N-column comparison matrix
BLK-MATRIX-ROW-LAYOUT.geometry: left row-label column (~1/12, small-caps 9.5pt: DESCRIPTION, REVENUE (€m), KPIs, TECHNOLOGIES) + 3 content columns each headed by a grey band (BUSINESS UNIT 1/2/3). Rows: bullets / BLK-BARCHART-CAGR / BLK-KPI-INLINE-TRIPLET / BLK-LOGO-PLACEHOLDER. Bottom full-width grey band.
BLK-MATRIX-ROW-LAYOUT.recipe: CSS grid: col template '1fr repeat(3, 1fr)', rows auto. Column headers = grey band (--gray-200) caps 9.5pt. Cells aligned to row labels. Fill every cell.

BLK-HERO-TRIANGLE.name: Hero triangle/pyramid divider shape
BLK-HERO-TRIANGLE.region: top band above columns, full width, ~90px tall
BLK-HERO-TRIANGLE.geometry: wide flat deal-primary triangle (clip-path) with a white ellipse cut-out centred (for a label/logo).
BLK-HERO-TRIANGLE.recipe: div with clip-path polygon triangle, --deal-primary; absolutely-positioned white ellipse centre. Decorative header.

BLK-KPI-INLINE-TRIPLET.name: Inline KPI triplet (rule-separated)
BLK-KPI-INLINE-TRIPLET.geometry: 3 KPIs in a row separated by thin vertical 0.25pt rules; each = value (9.5pt bold) over small-caps label (9.5pt). e.g. '[x]% RE(OC)CURRING REVENUE | [x]% CONTR. MARGIN | [x] FTEs'.
BLK-KPI-INLINE-TRIPLET.recipe: flex row, 3 cells, border-left 0.25pt grey between; center text; 9.5pt.

BLK-LOGO-PLACEHOLDER.name: Dashed logo/tech placeholder box
BLK-LOGO-PLACEHOLDER.geometry: dashed 1px grey border, radius 4px, empty; holds partner/tech logos (real transparent PNGs when supplied).
BLK-LOGO-PLACEHOLDER.recipe: Use ThirdPartyLogoPlaceholder (grey) for suppliers/tech; yellow TargetCompanyLogoPlaceholder only for the deal target.

BLK-BRIDGE-DONUT-PROGRESSION.name: Donut bridge (A + B = C) with deltas
BLK-BRIDGE-DONUT-PROGRESSION.geometry: 3 groups, each 2 donuts with a → between and a '+€[x]m' dashed delta box beneath; groups joined by ⊕ and = coin badges. Below: 3 category header bars (navy/blue/grey) each over harvey-ball rating rows.
BLK-BRIDGE-DONUT-PROGRESSION.recipe: flex row: group(donut→donut + delta) [+badge] group [=badge] group. Donuts = Donut component. Delta = dashed box 9.5pt.

BLK-HARVEYBALL-RATING-ROW.name: 5-box fill rating row
BLK-HARVEYBALL-RATING-ROW.geometry: row of 5 small squares filled 0–5 (solid / hatched / empty) + label beneath in italic 9.5pt ('[x]% recurring','[x]% reoccurring','[x]% perpetual','[x]% other'). Solid=deal-primary, hatched=pattern, empty=outline.
BLK-HARVEYBALL-RATING-ROW.recipe: flex row of 5 14px squares; fill n solid, m hatched, rest outline; caption 9.5pt italic centered.

BLK-CATEGORY-HEADER-BAR.name: Full-width category header bar
BLK-CATEGORY-HEADER-BAR.geometry: solid colour bar (navy / blue / grey) full width of its column, white caps label 9.5pt centred, radius 2px.
BLK-CATEGORY-HEADER-BAR.recipe: div background deal ramp colour; color #fff; caps 9.5pt; height ~30px.

BLK-MA-REVENUE-EVOLUTION.name: Buy-and-build revenue column chart with acquisition bubbles + tracker rows
BLK-MA-REVENUE-EVOLUTION.geometry: column chart across years 2017–2025 (last bar hatched forecast), value labels 9.5pt above. Acquisition logo-bubbles (circular, coloured by BU) float above/on bars with dashed callout boxes. Rotated axis label left 'REVENUE EVOLUTION (€M)'. Legend top-left (BU1/2/3 coloured circle + label). Beneath: 3 tracker rows with left small-caps labels — FTEs (pale boxes per year), EBITDA (grey arrow band with €[x]m segments), M&A (coloured dashed period bars 2021/2023/2024).
BLK-MA-REVENUE-EVOLUTION.recipe: Stack: (1) ColumnChart w/ forecast hatch + absolute logo-bubbles; (2) row 'FTEs' of pale value boxes aligned to columns; (3) 'EBITDA' grey chevron-arrow band; (4) 'M&A' coloured dashed period bars. Left rotated axis label. All 9.5pt.

BLK-CENTRAL-ARROW-TIMELINE.name: Central horizontal arrow timeline (dual-sided)
BLK-CENTRAL-ARROW-TIMELINE.geometry: thick deal-primary arrow spanning full width with year nodes (filled blue = key, grey = minor circles). Events on vertical stems above AND below the arrow: year in italic 9.5pt + [x] text; some milestones carry a yellow COMPANY LOGO box. Year labels bold 9.5pt at the arrow.
BLK-CENTRAL-ARROW-TIMELINE.recipe: Arrow = div w/ right-pointing clip-path, --deal-primary. Nodes = circles on the line. Stems = 1px grey vertical lines to callouts (italic year 9.5pt + text). Logo milestones = TargetCompanyLogoPlaceholder.

BLK-VERTICAL-PHOTO-TIMELINE.name: Vertical photo timeline
BLK-VERTICAL-PHOTO-TIMELINE.geometry: vertical line with milestone dots; each milestone = small photo thumb + [x] label (9.5pt); a COMPANY LOGO panel top-right; rotated [x] group labels.
BLK-VERTICAL-PHOTO-TIMELINE.recipe: vertical flex; each row: dot + photo (image-slot) + 9.5pt label. Line = 1px grey.

BLK-PHOTO-CARD-ROW.name: Photo card + content panel row
BLK-PHOTO-CARD-ROW.geometry: photo card (rounded grey) on left + content panel(s) right (bullet list / 2-step chevron / KPI grid). Dotted connector from a far-left vertical [x] tab to a node.
BLK-PHOTO-CARD-ROW.recipe: flex row: photo card (image-slot, radius 6px) + panel. Connector = dashed line + dot. 9.5pt.

BLK-CHEVRON-PROCESS.name: Numbered chevron process
BLK-CHEVRON-PROCESS.geometry: grey chevron steps with ① ② numbered coins + caps label; bullets beneath each. 9.5pt.
BLK-CHEVRON-PROCESS.recipe: Use ProcessFlow; numbered coin + caps label 9.5pt; bullets below.

BLK-PAGE-TAB-NAV.name: Footer page-tab navigator
BLK-PAGE-TAB-NAV.geometry: row of section tabs; active = deal-primary fill with white caps section name expanded (e.g. '1 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY'), others = grey number boxes 2–7,A; then COMPANY LOGO yellow box; then page number.
BLK-PAGE-TAB-NAV.recipe: Use FooterNav; active tab expanded deal-primary; 9.5pt caps.

BLK-COMPANY-LOGO-YELLOW.name: Company/target logo placeholder (yellow)
BLK-COMPANY-LOGO-YELLOW.geometry: SOLID yellow/gold fill (#ffd… ), RED 1px border, 'COMPANY LOGO' in navy 9.5pt caps centred. This is the confirmed house placeholder — mandatory, never collapses.
BLK-COMPANY-LOGO-YELLOW.recipe: Update TargetCompanyLogoPlaceholder to SOLID yellow fill + red (1px solid) border + navy caps text (current dashed border is WRONG — real is solid red border).
